output_text:
Rusty Commit (`rco`): Rust AI-powered commit message generator. Repo: https://github.com/hongkongkiwi/rusty-commit. Version 1.0.24 (2026-02-02); binary `rco` / `rusty-commit`; ~15,500 lines, 58 source files. Trait-based providers; async/await with tokio. Dependencies: tokio 1.35, clap 4.5, git2 0.20, async-openai 0.32, rmcp 0.13.

Safety:
`git push`, `git reset --hard`, `git clean -fd`
`rm -rf` or deleting files outside project dir
Modifying system files or installing system packages
**Never hardcode or log** API keys/tokens
**Verify `.gitignore`** excludes sensitive files before committing
Use `keyring` for secure storage (falls back to file with 0o600 perms)
**No `unwrap()`** in production paths (use `?`)

Architecture: CLI (`cli.rs`) → Commands (`commands/`) → Providers (`providers/`) → Utils (`utils/`). `AIProvider: Send + Sync` defines `async fn generate_commit_message(&self, diff: &str, context: Option<&str>) -> Result<String>;`. Source: `main.rs`, `lib.rs`, `cli.rs`, `config.rs`, `git.rs`, `update.rs`, `auth/`, `commands/`, `providers/`, `skills/`, `config/`, `utils/`; tests: 10 integration test files. For diffs > 5,000 lines, request user to stage specific files; 2,000–5,000 lines, use subagents for parallel exploration. Multiple independent modules: spawn parallel tasks.

Provider support includes Anthropic (`anthropic`, OAuth), OpenAI, Gemini, xAI/Grok, Groq, Cerebras, SambaNova, Nebius, OpenRouter, Together, Fireworks, Replicate, DeepInfra, Novita, Azure, Bedrock, Vertex, Mistral, Cohere, AI21, Perplexity, Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, MLX, Moonshot, SiliconFlow, Zhipu, MiniMax, DashScope, Lambda, Hyperbolic, Kluster, Scaleway, OVHcloud, Helicone, Cloudflare Workers AI, Hugging Face, NVIDIA NIM, Flowise, GitHub Copilot (OAuth), plus 70+ OpenAI-compatible providers.

Add a provider:
1. Create `src/providers/newprovider.rs`
2. Implement `AIProvider` trait
3. Add to factory in `src/providers/mod.rs`
4. Add feature flag in `Cargo.toml`
5. **Add tests** in `tests/`

Config precedence: per-repo > global > env > defaults. Global: `~/.config/rustycommit/config.{toml,json}`; per-repo: `.rustycommit.toml` or `.rco.toml`; env prefix `RCO_*`: `RCO_AI_PROVIDER`, `RCO_MODEL`, `RCO_API_KEY`, `RCO_API_URL`, `RCO_COMMIT_TYPE` (`conventional` or `gitmoji`), `RCO_EMOJI` (`true`/`false`), `RCO_LANGUAGE`.

Skills: `~/.config/rustycommit/skills/<name>/`; files `skill.toml` (manifest), `prompt.md` (template), `hooks/` (optional scripts: pre_gen, post_gen, format). Placeholders: `{diff}`, `{context}`, `{language}`, `{commit_type}`.

Commit format: Conventional Commits, `type(scope): description`; types: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `test`, `chore`, `perf`, `ci`, `build`.

Tests:
cargo test              # All tests
cargo test --all-features
cargo test test_name    # Specific test
cargo test -- --nocapture  # With output
**Must add tests for:**
New AI providers (integration test)
New CLI commands
Bug fixes (regression test)

Build:
cargo build --release
cargo build --all-features
cargo build --features secure-storage
cargo build --no-default-features --features openai  # Minimal
just build     # via justfile
just all       # fmt + clippy + test

Troubleshooting: 401 / invalid API key: `rco auth login` or set `RCO_API_KEY`; 429: wait; try lighter model. Secure stor
